info.name: Lists all disks in the project and returns their details.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the disks.

params.name: disk_ids
params.description: Filters results to disks with these IDs.

params.name: location
params.description: Filters results to disks in this location.

params.name: disk_names
params.description: Filters results to disks with these names.

params.name: exclude_os
params.description: Excludes OS disks from the results when true.

items.docs: Size of disks will be in gibibytes (GiB)

info.name: Creates a disk in the project and returns the async operation.

items.docs:
Requires either a disk snapshot ID, or size and location, where size of disk
should be in gibibytes (GiB) or tebibytes (TiB) in the format [Size][Unit].
E.g. 10GiB. Disk type must be one of: DISK_TYPE_PERSISTENT_SSD.
A successful response from this resource will contain the async operation.

info.name: Returns details for a single disk in the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the disk.

items.docs: Size of disk will be in gibibytes (GiB)

info.name: Resizes a disk in the project and returns the async operation.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the disk.

items.docs:
Size should be in gibibytes (GiB) or tebibytes (TiB) in the format
[Size][Unit]. E.g. 10GiB A successful response from this resource will
contain the async operation.

info.name: Deletes a disk from the project and returns the async operation.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the disk.
